beats.care: Use bike taxis to beat traffic? Rides on unpermitted vehicles may face action, so keep a backup like PMPML or metro.
beats.what: Vishrantwadi police booked Roppen Transportation Services, which runs Rapido, on a complaint from an RTO motor vehicle inspector.
beats.why: The RTO says Rapido's app let people book rides on petrol two-wheelers that were never permitted for passenger transport.
